title: Local application services
target: Owned background GUI services and app export worker; no keyboard/mouse or foreground UI acceptance

cases.title: Local animated graphic renders across its range
cases.expected: The native local generation completes for its exact revision; decoded frames 0, 24 and 47 show the authored marker at the correct distinct positions in a 1080p24 timeline.
steps: Read the selected package’s Remotion authoring facts and create a local moving-marker graphic.
Wait for the exact job, generation and revision to succeed; independently read its placement and content identity.
Decode early, middle and late frames; verify marker position, raster and changing pixels.

evidence.caption: Three independently rendered early, middle and late frames, with measured marker positions and file hashes.

cases.title: Duplicate admitted MGFX with default descriptor fields
cases.expected: A successfully admitted graphic with an omitted optional group label duplicates without a descriptor error.

cases.title: Independent graphic duplication
cases.expected: Application duplication creates independent generation and compound identities; editing copied parameters changes copied pixels only.

cases.title: Independent generated clip copy
cases.expected: The application operation used by MGFX copy/paste creates independent MGFX state; editing the copy preserves original values and pixels. Keyboard clipboard remains separate.

cases.title: Undo and redo a graphic publication
cases.expected: Undo removes the generated placement; redo restores its identities and rendered pixels. Retained undo files are not classified as orphaned artifacts.

cases.title: Persist independently edited graphics
cases.expected: A fresh owned process restores generation values, compound placements and rendered pixels.

cases.title: Application ProRes export
cases.expected: The app export worker renders and publishes 48 decodable 1080p24 ProRes frames with PCM audio.

cases.title: Application AV1 export
cases.expected: The app export worker renders and publishes 48 decodable 1080p24 AV1 frames with AAC audio.

cases.title: Ten-minute idle editor CPU
cases.expected: The owned editor remains paused and unchanged for ten minutes. Over the final five minutes, average CPU is at most 2% and time-weighted p95 is at most 5% of one CPU core. Limits are provisional; raw process CPU and RSS samples are retained.
